Maya (PM): quick async lane-handoff — can owners drop shipped/slipped + any active CR pings? we need a concise list for the exec summary by EOD. callouts: routing perf okr, console rollout, and dedupe-caching work.
Ajay (Eng): routing perf: shipped hotfix for tail-latency (deployed last night). throughput tests green. owner: Ajay. no open CRs. :tada:
Sophia (Eng-Platform): console rollout: partial ship — metrics dashboard + rollout toggle are in. slipped: rollout automation (scripts) delayed due to infra churn. owner: Sophia. CRs: @Ajay pinged me on #4567 (UI review) — awaiting his thumbs up.
Ajay (Eng): saw the UI diff, mostly nits. I'll finish review today AM and merge. CR: https://git.internal/redwood/repo/pull/4567
Carlos (Eng-SRE): dedupe-caching: PoC done, but we found memory growth on long-tail sessions in staging. owner: Carlos. slipping this sprint — moving to next. mitigation: revert to cache-v1 on heavy sessions, and add mem caps. action: will open an ops-runbook PR.
Maya (PM): super helpful — can each owner add 1-line next step + ETA? aim for public-facing status doc.
Ajay (Eng): next step: merge UI fixes + smoke test, ETA: today EOD.
Sophia (Eng-Platform): next step: finish automation scripts + integrate rollout toggle with canary, ETA: +4 working days.
Carlos (Eng-SRE): next step: add mem caps + run extended soak in staging, ETA: +3 working days. will file the runbook by tomorrow.
DeployBot: deployment note — routing-perf hotfix deployed at 2791234000 by ajay-dev, tags: deploy/hotfix-routing. :rocket:
Maya (PM): thanks team. I'll collate into the exec snippet. if any owner expects slips beyond the ETAs above, ping here asap. :thumbsup:
